ideas.pitch: An agentic data pipeline using Claude and Python that autonomously queries raw NASA Kepler or TESS light curve data, cleans the time-series noise, and flags candidate exoplanet transit dips with zero human intervention.
ideas.title: Astro-Agent: Autonomous Exoplanet Transit Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the domain knowledge and technical skills criteria by executing complex astronomical data cleaning which normally takes hours, mirroring the autonomous data incident response pattern of winning agentic hacks.

ideas.pitch: A vector-indexed retrieval-augmented generation toolkit built specifically for astronomical spectral signatures, allowing researchers to query thousands of stellar spectra using natural language.
ideas.title: SpectraMatch RAG: Deep Sky Semantic Database
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven auto-embedding and RAG toolkit pattern, giving judges an immediately demonstrable application for processing complex, unstructured astronomical literature and data.

ideas.pitch: A text-to-dashboard generator tailored for astrophysics datasets, translating natural language queries from astronomers into interactive web visualizations on the fly.
ideas.title: CosmoDash: Instant Astronomical Data-to-Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning formula of the Tableau DataDev Hackathon by bridging the gap between raw data stores and instant, readable visual insights for judges.

ideas.pitch: A frontend digital twin platform visualizing active space debris and low-earth orbit satellite constellations with predictive trajectory monitoring and collision risk alerts.
ideas.title: Orbital Digital Twin: Real-Time Satellite Tracking
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the proven success of frontend-heavy digital twin and predictive data visualization hacks that score heavily on execution and final results.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video intelligence platform adapted to scan through high-resolution time-lapse telescope imagery to automatically detect moving Near-Earth Objects (NEOs).
ideas.title: CosmicVision: Deep Field Video Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the exact grand prize winning architecture of the Data & Design Hackathon's LibrAI platform to unstructured astronomical video data, maximizing perceived technical novelty.
